mapper.insert: INSERT INTO userapps_heartbeat (id, userapp_id, ip, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, geoip) VALUES (#{id}, #{userappId}, #{ip}, #{firstSeenAt}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{geoip,typeHandler=com.ghostchu.btn.sparkle.converter.JsonbTypeHandler}) ON CONFLICT (userapp_id, ip) DO UPDATE SET last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at, geoip = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.geoip, userapps_heartbeat.geoip), first_seen_at = GREATEST(userapps_heartbeat.first_seen_at, NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days');

INSERT INTO userapps_heartbeat ( id, userapp_id, ip, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, geoip ) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.userappId}, #{item.ip}, #{item.firstSeenAt}, #{item.lastSeenAt}, #{item.geoip,typeHandler=com.ghostchu.btn.sparkle.converter.JsonbTypeHandler})
ON CONFLICT (userapp_id, ip) DO UPDATE SET last_seen_at = GREATEST( userapps_heartbeat.last_seen_at, EXCLUDED.last_seen_at ), geoip = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.geoip, userapps_heartbeat.geoip), first_seen_at = GREATEST( LEAST( userapps_heartbeat.first_seen_at, EXCLUDED.first_seen_at ), NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' )
